changeSet.author: stayhub
changeSet.comment: Xóa cứng các chi nhánh DRAFT đã xóa mềm để giải phóng branch_code

changeSet.author: stayhub
changeSet.comment: Gắn hậu tố _OFF_ cho branch_code của chi nhánh COMPLETED đã xóa mềm
changeSet.sql: UPDATE branches SET branch_code = branch_code || '_OFF_' || id WHERE is_deleted = true AND creation_status = 'COMPLETED' AND branch_code IS NOT NULL AND branch_code NOT LIKE '%\_OFF\_%' ESCAPE '\' AND branch_code NOT LIKE '%\_DEL\_%' ESCAPE '\';

changeSet.author: stayhub
changeSet.comment: Đưa chi nhánh COMPLETED đã xóa mềm về trạng thái SUSPENDED và bỏ cờ is_deleted
changeSet.sql: UPDATE branches SET creation_status = 'SUSPENDED', is_active = false, is_deleted = false, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE is_deleted = true AND creation_status = 'COMPLETED';

changeSet.author: stayhub
changeSet.comment: Gắn hậu tố _OFF_ cho branch_code của chi nhánh SUSPENDED còn giữ mã gốc
changeSet.sql: UPDATE branches SET branch_code = branch_code || '_OFF_' || id WHERE creation_status = 'SUSPENDED' AND branch_code IS NOT NULL AND branch_code NOT LIKE '%\_OFF\_%' ESCAPE '\' AND branch_code NOT LIKE '%\_DEL\_%' ESCAPE '\';
